cases.name: Rolling aggregations with per-row offset_date
cases.input: Create rolling 30-day and 90-day mean and count features for the measurement_value column, grouped by part_id, respecting the per-row offset_date.
expected_behaviors: Filters events with strict less-than on offset_date (not less-than-or-equal)
Uses per-row offset_date, not a global cutoff date
Returns NaN for entities with no history before offset_date (not zero)
Computes both mean and count for each window size
Handles date parsing with errors='coerce' and drops NaT rows
should_not: Use a global offset_date cutoff (e.g., df[df['date'] < max_offset])
Fill NaN rolling features with zero (distinguishes 'no data' from 'zero mean')
Include events on or after offset_date in the aggregation

cases.name: Fold-aware target encoding for medium-cardinality categorical
cases.input: Target encode the 'supplier_code' column (35 unique values) using the defect_rate target column.
expected_behaviors: Uses KFold cross-validation to compute out-of-fold encodings
Applies smoothing to shrink category means toward global mean
Maps unseen categories in validation folds to global mean
Returns a Series aligned to the original dataframe index
Explains that full-dataset target encoding would cause leakage
should_not: Compute target encoding on the full dataset without fold splitting
Use target encoding without smoothing (high overfitting risk)
Leave unseen categories as NaN without a fallback value

cases.name: Feature interaction creation from top-importance features
cases.input: Create pairwise interaction features from the top 10 most important features identified by LightGBM.
expected_behaviors: Creates interactions only from top-importance features, not all features
Uses PolynomialFeatures with interaction_only=True and degree=2
Drops original features from the interaction output (keeps only cross-terms)
Follows interaction creation with feature selection to control feature count
Warns about feature explosion (10 features → 45 interactions)
should_not: Create interactions from all features in the dataset
Skip feature selection after creating interactions

cases.name: Frequency encoding for high-cardinality categorical
cases.input: Encode the 'error_code' column which has 200+ unique values.
expected_behaviors: Uses frequency encoding (not one-hot) for high cardinality
Computes relative frequency (normalize=True) for values between 0 and 1
Handles unseen categories at inference by mapping to 0.0 or small epsilon
Explains that frequency encoding is leakage-safe (no target information used)
should_not: Use one-hot encoding for 200+ unique values (feature explosion)
Use target encoding without fold-aware computation for this column
Leave unseen categories as NaN at inference without a fallback

cases.name: Lag features with monthly lookback periods
cases.input: Create lag features for the last 1, 3, and 6 months of production_count for each machine_id, using offset_date as the cutoff.
expected_behaviors: Computes lag features using pd.DateOffset(months=lag) for calendar-accurate periods
Filters history to events strictly before offset_date
Returns mean of values within each lag period
Returns NaN for entities with no data in a lag period (not zero)
Uses per-row offset_date for each machine_id row
should_not: Use pd.Timedelta(days=30*lag) instead of pd.DateOffset(months=lag) for monthly lags
Include events on or after offset_date in lag computation
Use a single global cutoff date for all rows
